q08. `Driver` — `store/driver.go` (interface defined at line 10).

It's implemented by all three database backends: `mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:14`), `postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:16`), and `sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:16`).
